datasets.title: Papua New Guinea Sea Ports (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['amenity'] = 'ferry_terminal' OR tags['building'] = 'ferry_terminal' OR tags['port'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: name name:en amenity building port operator:type addr:full addr:city source name:ho name:tpi This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_png_sea_ports]
datasets.details: OpenStreetMap data is crowd sourced and cannot be considered to be exhaustive

lineage.description: Sea port infrastructure features were extracted from OpenStreetMap using amenity and building tags matching ferry terminals and port facilities. The dataset provides spatial geometry (points, lines, polygons) and attribute information for port infrastructure across Papua New Guinea, enabling exposure assessment of critical maritime infrastructure.
